source_script: I've been a night-shift ICU nurse for eleven years, and I used to think being wired at 2am was just part of the job. If you're a shift worker who lies there staring at the ceiling after a twelve-hour shift, you know exactly what I mean. Week one I started taking one of these magnesium gummies before bed and just felt a little less jittery. By week two I was actually falling asleep within twenty minutes instead of lying awake for an hour. I keep the jar right on my bathroom counter next to the sink so I never forget it after I wash my face at midnight. On my day off I toss a few in my bag and take them on the break room couch before my nap between shifts. No prescription, no weird aftertaste, just one gummy before you lie down.
